title.en: Publish the signed-in multilingual learning QA result
title.zh: 发布真实登录多语言学习验收结果

purpose.en: Record the completed signed-in Chrome acceptance for Course learning, Learn through play, Everyday Speaking, and the vocabulary speech recovery across four target languages.
purpose.zh: 记录真实账号在 Chrome 完成的四语言课程学习、边玩边学、生活口语与词汇跟读恢复验收。

en: Verify English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian through one signed-in Chinese-interface learner.
Complete and persist the five course skills plus the daily quiz for the newly joined Japanese, Spanish, and Italian courses.
Verify Course, Learn through play, Everyday Speaking, and AI entry tabs for all four joined languages.
zh: 使用一个中文界面真实学习账号验收英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语。
新加入的日语、西班牙语和意大利语课程均完成并保存五项技能及每日测验。
验证四种已加入语言均显示课程、边玩边学、生活口语和咨询 AI 入口标签。
真实用户 QA 报告

en: Create no-charge 30-day app-local access for the Japanese, Spanish, and Italian test courses and verify all five course entries.
Persist real vocabulary reviews, reading, writing, listening, dialogue, and server-graded quiz evidence from the test learner.
Confirm the speech watchdog restores Continue and Skip in Japanese, Spanish, and Italian when the Chrome test session has no audio input.
zh: 为日语、西班牙语和意大利语测试课程建立不收费的 30 天应用内试学资格，并验证全部五项课程入口。
由真实测试账号保存词汇复习、阅读、写作、听力、对话及服务器判分测验记录。
确认 Chrome 测试会话没有音频输入时，日语、西班牙语和意大利语的超时保护都会恢复继续与跳过按钮。

en: Japanese, Spanish, and Italian each show 1,000 Beginner words, twenty words per page, phonetics, persisted progress, and a recoverable pronunciation flow.

Japanese, Spanish, and Italian daily quizzes each scored 100/100; their learning calendars contain all five skill categories. Existing English five-skill evidence, Play, and Everyday Speaking were also verified.
The Dashboard shows all four joined languages in every learning area, the introducer balance remains zero, and the browser error log is empty.
TypeScript, sensitive-data scan, all 307 repository tests, and production deployment run 32498418381 pass.
zh: 日语、西班牙语和意大利语均显示 1000 个初级词、每页 20 词、音标、持久进度和可恢复跟读流程。
日语、西班牙语和意大利语每日测验均为 100/100，学习日历均包含五项技能；现有英语五项记录、边玩边学和生活口语也已验证。
用户面板在每个学习区域显示四种已加入语言，介绍人积分仍为 0，浏览器错误日志为空。
TypeScript、敏感数据扫描、仓库全部 307 项测试和生产部署 32498418381 均已通过。

en: Acoustic pronunciation scoring was not passed: the controlled Chrome session supplied no real audio input. Recovery and manual continuation passed, while acoustic scoring remains capability-limited.
zh: 声学发音评分未标记通过：受控 Chrome 会话没有提供真实音频输入。恢复与手动继续已通过，声学评分仍标记为能力受限。

en: This report records SmartLingo test-account learning evidence only and does not alter other portfolio sites.
zh: 本报告仅记录 SmartLingo 测试账号学习证据，不改变其他站点。
